rollout_decision.reason: Backend, wallet API, full-stack Playwright, UX/accessibility, QR/export no-leak, and label-review evidence are recorded; production binary, verifier-key, HSM, CI, and release-owner controls remain explicit cutover gates.

coverage: ProveKit WHIR backend proof generation and verification

assertions: proof receipts preserve backend metadata, verifier IDs, artifact refs, public-input hashes, and verification state
fail-closed disabled/unavailable/artifact-mismatch paths are surfaced without silent downgrade
private axioms, witness text, local artifact paths, and raw proof payloads are excluded from response surfaces
proof creation and listing work with deterministic ProveKit fixtures
QR review, export/import, audit refresh, provider, and public surfaces render sanitized proof metadata
disabled, unavailable, artifact mismatch, and backend error states fail closed
desktop and mobile layouts do not overflow
keyboard focus and touch target coverage are verified
visible copy avoids legal or cryptographic overclaiming

proof_system_label_review.decision: ProveKit WHIR evidence is not labeled as Groth16, EVM-verifiable, or on-chain-ready without independent recursive-wrapper evidence.
